notes: Smoother online play. Octagon: the rollback netcode had been switched off by mistake since the rename to Pixel Games (the version number reset confused it) — it's back on, and corrections now ease in instead of snapping. Hoops: your own player now moves the instant you press a key instead of waiting a round trip, while the host still has the final say. Racer: other cars no longer stutter on a jittery connection, and they keep rolling through a late packet instead of freezing. Everyone in a game should update to this version.
